question.text: Client reviews an IPS and finds the PM has exceeded tactical bands (e.g., equity at 75% vs 60-70% SAA band). The client should:

answer.text: Raise in writing; PM must justify or rebalance

explanation.text: The Logic: IPS breach → client query → PM justification or corrective action. Escalation to SEBI if unresolved. The Trap: Going straight to SEBI skips dispute-resolution process. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B best practice. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain a breach log — institutional clients demand this transparency.
